findings.summary: The restart contract did not require the regression cases needed to prove the one-use controls.
findings.evidence: Proposal v2 specified durable checkpoints and generic two-process serialization but omitted required tests for successor intent-only and body-without-receipt terminalization, completed-page local replay, and exactly one concurrent credential and transport owner.
findings.required_correction: Freeze an explicit implementation-test contract covering each crash checkpoint, completed-page replay, and two-process serialization.

findings.summary: The public terminal allowlist constrained only top-level fields.
findings.evidence: Proposal v2 permitted nested dataset lineage, privacy, scientific, and disabled-authority objects without exact recursive key and value contracts.
findings.required_correction: Freeze exact nested schemas and branch semantics, use one validated private-to-public projection, and reject unknown nested keys before credential or private-root access.

findings.summary: The cumulative request cap left the effective maximum response envelope ambiguous by one page.
findings.evidence: The predecessor intent-only frontier consumes one of 22,176 combined intents, while the successor must create a second intent to obtain that page; therefore at most 22,175 response pages can be retained under the unchanged combined intent ceiling.
findings.required_correction: Freeze the 22,175 effective combined-response envelope and classify an additional required page as terminal combined-request-budget exhaustion without source-missing inference.

findings.summary: The successor did not freeze one exact private root or the complete two-root lock lifetime.
findings.evidence: A merely distinct Program 013 root and generic serialization allow separate roots or early lock release to create multiple claim owners or a predecessor-validation TOCTOU window.
findings.required_correction: Freeze one non-overridable repository-relative Program 013 root and run.lock; acquire the successor exclusive lock before any predecessor access, then the predecessor read lock, and hold both through public terminal persistence.

findings.summary: Recovery checkpoints were not fully immutable or bound to the reviewed child, runtime, and predecessor import.
findings.evidence: Proposal v2 did not define exact claim, intent, receipt, import-manifest, and private-terminal schemas; bodies and receipts were not explicitly create-only; and checkpoint bindings did not include the proposal, child, runtime, and predecessor-import identities.
findings.required_correction: Freeze exact create-only canonical checkpoint schemas and bind every checkpoint to proposal, child, runtime, and import-manifest identities before credentials or transport.

findings.summary: Public terminal result branches were not mechanically consistent.
findings.evidence: Proposal v2 did not bind each result kind to exact status, admission, and pass-only dataset-lineage semantics, so a shallowly valid artifact could contradict the private terminal.
findings.required_correction: Freeze exact result-kind branch mappings and derive repository and CLI output from one byte-exact validated private terminal projection.

findings.summary: Credential access omitted the inherited crash-safe value-free audit protocol.
findings.evidence: Proposal v2 limited loads per process but did not require a durable pre-access attempt, success or failure receipt, process latch, conservative unpaired-attempt accounting, or private terminal load accounting.
findings.required_correction: Restore the Program 012 credential attempt and receipt protocol, bind it to the child and runtime, count unpaired attempts as loads, and retain only private counts.

scope_limit: The reviews made no credential access, provider request, private market-data read, strategy calculation, controlled or protected read, PAPER action, broker write, live action, or purchase.
required_next_action: Preserve proposal v2, issue a prospective v3 resolving all seven findings, and obtain fresh design and security-boundary reviews before implementation.
